clips.title: The story
paras: A letter from Westfall brings Magistrate Solomon a hard answer in Lakeshire. He asked Gryan Stoutmantle for soldiers to defend Redridge, but Westfall has been left to face its own troubles.

Magistrate Solomon faces growing troubles in the Redridge Mountains without Stormwind's royal garrison. He looks to the southern frontier for help and writes to Gryan Stoutmantle, commander of the People's Militia in Westfall. Solomon hopes the volunteers at Sentinel Hill can spare fighters to strengthen Lakeshire's defenses. He does not know how hard pressed the western plains are.

Gryan Stoutmantle refuses, though the answer weighs heavily on him. Westfall is fighting the Defias Brotherhood and marauding gnolls because the House of Nobles and the crown have abandoned the kingdom's breadbasket. The People's Militia formed so the people could survive. Its ranks lose good men each day, and Stoutmantle cannot spare a single fighter for Redridge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read. But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia. If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.
Take this response to your master in Redridge, adventurer. And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon? Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I do say, this is not good at all. I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire. What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people? Bah, I should not ponder aloud.
Here, messenger. Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township. I might call upon you again.
